TestProfile
Profile dropdown: clicking the profile picture in the top navigation expands the dropdown and exposes the 'View Profile Details' link
Navigation: selecting 'View Profile Details' from the profile dropdown navigates to the Profile page and renders the 'Basic Information' section header
Profile picture upload: uploading a valid PNG image as the profile avatar succeeds and a confirmation toast is shown
Profile picture validation: uploading a PDF file as the profile avatar is rejected by the client-side validator and an error toast is shown
Profile picture replace: uploading a different valid image (JPG) replaces the existing avatar and the success toast is displayed
Basic Information edit: clicking the 'Edit' link on the Basic Information card switches the section into edit mode and renders the 'Save' button
Basic Information validation: submitting a blank (whitespace-only) First Name displays the inline error 'First name cannot be blank'
Basic Information edit: updating the First Name to 'Cathy' persists the change and the new value is reflected in the profile header after save
Basic Information edit: updating both First Name and Last Name to 'Ethelyn Kemmer' persists and the combined display name is rendered in the profile header
Basic Information validation: submitting a blank (whitespace-only) Last Name is silently accepted and the profile reverts to the first-name-only display
Basic Information validation: clearing the Sex (gender) selection and attempting to save displays the inline error 'Sex is required'
Basic Information edit: selecting Sex as 'Male' and saving persists the value and renders 'Male' in the read-only Basic Information view
Basic Information edit: selecting Sex as 'Female' and saving persists the value and renders 'Female' in the read-only Basic Information view
Basic Information edit: clearing the Date of Birth field and attempting to save is handled gracefully without crashing the form
Basic Information edit: selecting a valid Date of Birth (15th of the previous month) and saving persists the new DOB successfully
Basic Information edit: selecting Timezone 'Eastern' from the dropdown and saving persists the timezone and renders 'Eastern' in the read-only view

Basic Information edit: editing the First Name and then clicking the close (X) icon without saving discards the change — the unsaved value does not appear in the profile and the previously saved values remain intact

Basic Information structural validation: the edit form exposes exactly the expected fields (firstName, lastName, email, dateOfBirth, gender, current_gender, timezone, preferredName) and a functional Save button with no unexpected inputs
Contact Details edit: clicking the 'Edit' link on the Contact Details card switches the section into edit mode and renders the 'Save' button
Contact Details validation: submitting a blank Contact Number displays the inline error 'Contact number is required'
Contact Details validation: entering alphabetic characters in the Contact Number field displays the inline error 'Contact number is invalid'
Contact Details validation: entering a Contact Number shorter than 10 digits displays the inline error 'Contact number must be at least 10 characters'
Contact Details edit: entering a valid 10-digit Contact Number and saving persists the value and renders it (prefixed with '+') in the read-only view
Contact Details validation: submitting a blank Address Line 1 displays the inline error 'Address line is required'
Contact Details edit: entering a valid Address Line 1 ('5356 Rose Street') and saving persists the value and renders it in the read-only address block
Contact Details edit: leaving Address Line 2 blank (optional field) and saving does not raise validation errors; the previously saved Address Line 1 remains intact and no Apt./line-2 text appears
Contact Details edit: entering a valid Address Line 2 ('Apt. 464') and saving persists the value and renders it within the read-only address block
Contact Details validation: submitting a blank City field displays the inline error 'City is required'
Contact Details edit: updating City to 'Los Angeles' and saving persists the value and renders it in the read-only address block
Contact Details validation: clearing the State dropdown selection and submitting displays the inline error 'State is required'
Contact Details edit: selecting 'California' from the State dropdown and saving persists the state and renders 'Los Angeles, CA' in the read-only address block
Contact Details validation: submitting a blank Zip Code displays the inline error 'Zip code is required'
Contact Details validation: entering a 4-digit Zip Code displays the inline error 'Zip code must have a leading zero if it's 4 digits long'
Contact Details validation: entering a 6-digit Zip Code displays the inline length error 'Zip code must be either 5 digits (XXXXX) or 9 digits (XXXXX-XXXX)'
Contact Details validation: entering 9 consecutive digits without the required dash separator displays the inline format error for 9-digit Zip Codes
Contact Details edit: entering a valid 9-digit Zip Code in XXXXX-XXXX format ('12345-9999') and saving persists the value and renders it in the read-only view

Address Confirmation: the 'I confirm' checkbox is checked by default with required-marker and bullet points visible; unchecking it and saving displays 'Please confirm address', and re-checking + saving clears the error

Contact Details structural validation: the edit form exposes exactly the expected fields (phone, addressLine1, addressLine2, city, state, zipCode, addressConfirmedCheckbox) with an 'I confirm' label and an enabled Save button — no unexpected inputs are present
Health Parameters edit: clicking the 'Edit' link on the Health Parameters card switches the section into edit mode and renders the 'Save' button, then closing the modal restores the read-only view
Health Parameters edit: selecting Height = 6 feet 2 inches and Physical Activity = 'Light' and saving persists the values and renders Feet=6 / Inches=2 in the read-only view
Health Parameters validation: entering alphabetic characters ('abcd') in the Waist field displays the inline error 'Waist is not a number'
Health Parameters edit: leaving the Waist (inches) field blank and saving defaults the stored value to '0inches' in the read-only view
Health Parameters edit: entering '0' in the Waist (inches) field and saving persists the literal value and renders '0inches' in the read-only view
Health Parameters validation (repeat): re-entering alphabetic characters in the Waist (inches) field after a prior save still displays the inline error 'Waist is not a number'
Health Parameters edit: entering a valid numeric Waist value (32 inches) and saving persists the value and renders '32' in the read-only view
Health Parameters edit: leaving the Hips (inches) field blank and saving defaults the stored value to '0inches' in the read-only view
Health Parameters edit: entering '0' in the Hips (inches) field and saving persists the literal value and renders '0inches' in the read-only view
Health Parameters validation: entering alphabetic characters in the Hips field displays the inline error 'Hips is not a number'
Health Parameters edit: entering a valid numeric Hips value (34 inches) and saving persists the value and renders '34' in the read-only view
Health Parameters edit: selecting Current Physical Activity = 'Medium' and saving persists the value and renders 'Medium' in the read-only view
Health Parameters edit: selecting My Diabetes Status = 'Diabetes' and saving persists the value and renders 'Diabetes' in the read-only view
Health Parameters edit: opening the Health Parameters edit modal and clicking the close (X) icon without changing any fields discards the modal and preserves prior values

Health Parameters structural validation: the edit modal exposes exactly the expected controls (Height Feet & Inches dropdowns, Waist input, Hips input, Physical Activity dropdown, Diabetes Status dropdown, Hypertension dropdown, Save button) with no unexpected input fields
Devices section: clicking the 'Devices' button on the Profile page reveals the supported integrations and the labels Withings, Garmin, and Fitbit are all rendered
Upload/View Files: navigating to 'Upload/View Files' from the profile dropdown renders the section header and exposes the 'Upload' control
Upload dialog: clicking the 'Upload' button opens the upload modal with the 'Upload' header and the accepted-formats / max-size helper text 'Max size 15MB (gif, jpg, jpeg, png, pdf)'
Upload validation: providing only a file (without Name and Type) and submitting displays the inline 'is required' error for the missing mandatory fields
Upload validation: providing only a document Name (without a file and Type) and submitting displays the inline 'is required' error for the missing mandatory fields
Upload validation: providing only a document Type (without a file and Name) and submitting displays the inline 'is required' error for the missing mandatory fields
Upload happy path: providing a valid file, Name='Test Document' and Type='Blood Report' and submitting uploads the document and the documents table row count increases by exactly one
Upload cancel: providing a valid file, Name and Type and then clicking 'Cancel' closes the dialog and the documents table row count remains unchanged
Upload validation (regression): providing only a document Name and submitting again after a page reload still displays the inline 'is required' error
Upload validation (regression): providing only a document Type and submitting again after a page reload still displays the inline 'is required' error
Upload happy path (second instance): providing a valid file, Name and Type and submitting uploads a second document and the documents table row count increases by exactly one
Upload cancel (second instance): providing a valid file, Name and Type and then clicking 'Cancel' closes the dialog and the documents table row count remains unchanged
Uploaded documents: clicking the 'View' icon on an uploaded document opens the document viewer and the original row is still present in the documents table
Uploaded documents: clicking the 'Delete' icon and confirming with 'Yes' on the confirmation dialog triggers the delete flow (current backend behavior leaves the row in the table)
Uploaded documents: clicking the 'Delete' icon and cancelling with 'No' on the confirmation dialog dismisses the dialog and the row remains intact in the documents table
Change Password: selecting 'Change Password' from the profile dropdown navigates to the Change Password section and exposes the 'View Profile Details' link in the dropdown
Change Password validation: submitting the form without entering any data displays 'is required' for Current Password, the min-length error for New Password, and 'is required' for Confirm Password
Change Password validation: entering only the Current Password and submitting displays the min-length error on New Password and 'is required' on Confirm Password
Change Password validation: entering only the New Password (without Current and Confirm) and submitting displays the inline 'is required' error on Confirm Password
Change Password validation: submitting an incorrect Current Password with matching New and Confirm Passwords displays the server-side error 'is incorrect' on Current Password
Change Password validation: submitting a New Password and a mismatching Confirm Password displays the inline error 'Passwords do not match' on Confirm Password
Language Preferences: selecting 'Language Preferences' from the profile dropdown opens the section and the 'Language Preferences' button label is rendered
Language Preferences: switching the application language to Spanish translates the profile dropdown UI and 'Contact Us' is rendered as 'Contáctanos'
Language Preferences: switching the application language back to English from Spanish restores the original UI translations and 'Contact Us' is rendered in English again
Notification Preferences: selecting 'Notification Preferences' from the profile dropdown opens the page with the 'Notification Preferences' header and the 'Habit Tracker' notification group
Notification Preferences toggles: toggling the 'Habit Tracker' Push and SMS notification switches flips the displayed state from On→Off (or Off→On) and reverts cleanly when toggled again
Notification Preferences toggles: toggling the 'Habit Tracker' Push and SMS notification switches flips the displayed state from On→Off (or Off→On) and reverts cleanly when toggled again
Manage Devices: selecting 'Manage Devices' from the profile dropdown opens the page and a connected device header (one of Withings/Garmin/Fitbit) is rendered

Profile dropdown contents: opening the profile dropdown exposes exactly the expected set of options (View Profile Details, Upload/View Files, Change Password, Notification Preferences, Manage Devices, Language Preferences, Guided Tour, Contact Us, Sign Out) with no missing or unexpected entries
Sign out: selecting 'Sign Out' from the profile dropdown logs the user out, navigates away from /app/dashboard, and renders the 'Terms of Use' link on the public landing page
